speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: As the position of the Leader of the Opposition is not dealt with in our Constitution or in the Standing Orders of Parliament, I should, for good order, state the duties and privileges of the Leader of the Opposition for the Parliamentary record.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: First, on the Leader of the Opposition’s Parliamentary privileges.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is the same practice as that in other countries which formally recognise the role of the Leader of the Opposition and was also observed by us in previous terms of Parliament in Singapore in respect of the leader of the main opposition party.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This will be at the Speaker’s discretion and subject to existing speaking conventions.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I will be moving a Motion to this effect later.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I have consulted the Speaker on these arrangements and he has agreed that they remain appropriate.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I have also apprised Mr Singh of this.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Next, I touch on the Leader of the Opposition’s Parliamentary duties.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: There are 12 opposition Members, of whom two are Non-Constituency MPs.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: From time to time, the Leader of the Opposition may receive confidential briefings by the Government, on matters to be determined by the Government.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: These briefings will promote better understanding across both sides of the House on important national issues such as security and external relations, especially in the event of a national crisis or emergency.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I congratulate Mr Singh on his continuation as the Leader of the Opposition.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I look forward to working with him on this Parliament’s mission to serve Singaporeans and build a stronger Singapore.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: As Speaker, I would also like to take this occasion to formally welcome Mr Pritam Singh as Leader of the Opposition in this 15th Parliament of Singapore.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The position of the Leader of the Opposition, and the duties and privileges accorded to the position, was first given formal recognition in the 14th Parliament.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The arrangements have worked out well and Parliamentary proceedings have gone on smoothly.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Such arrangements will continue in this 15th Parliament – a second time the position is formally recognised – with Mr Pritam Singh continuing to lead and to organise the Opposition’s Parliamentary business.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The role of the Leader of the Opposition could continue to evolve in future.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The position’s duties and privileges may then be correspondingly updated, where necessary, to best meet Singapore’s Parliamentary context, bearing in mind the objective of having the opposition scrutinise the Government’s positions and actions in Parliament, and presenting alternative views and proposals for debate.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Having worked with both the Leader of the House and the Leader of the Opposition in the 14th Parliament, I ask for their support and continued cooperation across the aisle, which will ensure that all Members, regardless of party, uphold the House’s decorum, dignity and honour at all times.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I look forward to working with them once again to conduct Parliamentary business and debates in an orderly, efficient and constructive manner in this 15th Parliament of Singapore.
